// Elliott Wave Plugin Licence: use needs a paid licence per domain (https://viewer.elliottwave.studio/pricing/).
// 3D Viewer: Framer code component. `pnpm --filter @elliottwave/viewer-framer build` writes the
// paste-ready copy to dist/Viewer3D.tsx with the script's SRI hash filled in. In Framer: Assets →
// Code → New Code File, paste, save. Docs: https://viewer.elliottwave.studio/platforms/framer/

import { addPropertyControls, ControlType, RenderTarget } from 'framer';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type Ref } from 'react';

/** Product identity and the pinned script. Renaming the product starts here; see RENAMING.md. */
export const CONFIG = {
  displayName: '3D Viewer',
  tagName: 'ew-viewer',
  version: '0.1.0',
  scriptUrl: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@elliottwave/viewer@0.1.0/dist/ew-viewer.min.js',
  integrity: 'sha384-KWnwxLSOxp4XkIskC2b2xU5Jd8yZLgF1NQfAoSPc8Bj7C664zdKhqjKb3rZED6y5',
  docsUrl: 'https://viewer.elliottwave.studio',
} as const;

export interface Viewer3DProps {
  model?: string;
  modelUrl?: string;
  alt?: string;
  iosModel?: string;
  iosModelUrl?: string;
  poster?: string;
  ar?: boolean;
  arLabel?: string;
  cameraControls?: boolean;
  autoRotate?: boolean;
  rotationSpeed?: number;
  shadowIntensity?: number;
  exposure?: number;
  transparent?: boolean;
  background?: string;
  loading?: 'lazy' | 'auto' | 'eager';
  tapToLoad?: boolean;
  /** Licence key for the published site's domain. */
  licenseKey?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
}

const HEX = /^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3,4}|[0-9a-f]{6}|[0-9a-f]{8})$/i;
const RGB = /^rgba?\(\s*[0-9.%\s,/]{1,60}\)$/i;

/**
 * Attribute list for <ew-viewer>. Boolean attributes are "" when on and absent when off.
 * `plugin` and `license-key` make <ew-viewer> check the licence against the published site's
 * hostname; on Framer's canvas there is no badge.
 */
export function viewerAttributes(p: Viewer3DProps, onCanvas = false): Record<string, string> {
  const attrs: Record<string, string> = {};
  const src = (p.modelUrl || p.model || '').trim();
  const ios = (p.iosModelUrl || p.iosModel || '').trim();
  if (src) attrs.src = src;
  if (ios) attrs['ios-src'] = ios;
  if (p.poster) attrs.poster = p.poster;
  if (p.alt?.trim()) attrs.alt = p.alt.trim();
  if (p.ar ?? true) attrs.ar = '';
  if (p.arLabel?.trim()) attrs['ar-label'] = p.arLabel.trim().slice(0, 60);
  if (p.cameraControls ?? true) attrs['camera-controls'] = '';
  if (p.autoRotate) {
    attrs['auto-rotate'] = '';
    if (typeof p.rotationSpeed === 'number' && Number.isFinite(p.rotationSpeed)) attrs['rotation-per-second'] = `${Math.round(p.rotationSpeed)}deg`;
  }
  if (typeof p.shadowIntensity === 'number') attrs['shadow-intensity'] = String(p.shadowIntensity);
  if (typeof p.exposure === 'number') attrs.exposure = String(p.exposure);
  if (p.transparent ?? true) attrs.background = 'transparent';
  else if (p.background && (HEX.test(p.background) || RGB.test(p.background))) attrs.background = p.background;
  attrs.height = '100%';
  attrs.loading = p.loading ?? 'lazy';
  if (p.tapToLoad) attrs.reveal = 'interaction';
  attrs.plugin = 'framer';
  const licenseKey = p.licenseKey?.trim();
  if (onCanvas) attrs['license-state'] = 'editor';
  else if (licenseKey) attrs['license-key'] = licenseKey;
  return attrs;
}

let loader: Promise<void> | null = null;

/** Adds the pinned, SRI-checked module script once per page. */
export function loadViewerScript(doc: Document = document): Promise<void> {
  if (customElements.get(CONFIG.tagName)) return Promise.resolve();
  if (loader) return loader;
  loader = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const script = doc.createElement('script');
    script.type = 'module';
    script.setAttribute('integrity', CONFIG.integrity);
    script.setAttribute('crossorigin', 'anonymous');
    script.src = CONFIG.scriptUrl;
    script.onload = () => customElements.whenDefined(CONFIG.tagName).then(() => resolve(), reject);
    script.onerror = () => {
      loader = null;
      reject(new Error(`${CONFIG.displayName}: could not load ${CONFIG.scriptUrl}`));
    };
    doc.head.append(script);
  });
  return loader;
}

const box: CSSProperties = { width: '100%', height: '100%', position: 'relative' };
const notice: CSSProperties = {
  ...box,
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  padding: 16,
  textAlign: 'center',
  font: '13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif',
  color: '#666',
  background: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)',
  borderRadius: 8,
};

/**
 * @framerSupportedLayoutWidth any
 * @framerSupportedLayoutHeight any
 * @framerIntrinsicWidth 480
 * @framerIntrinsicHeight 480
 */
export default function Viewer3D(props: Viewer3DProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const attrs = viewerAttributes(props, RenderTarget.current() === RenderTarget.canvas);
  const key = JSON.stringify(attrs);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadViewerScript().catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    for (const name of el.getAttributeNames()) if (!(name in attrs)) el.removeAttribute(name);
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(attrs)) el.setAttribute(name, value);
    // `key` captures every attribute value.
  }, [key]);

  if (!attrs.src) return <div style={{ ...notice, ...props.style }}>Add a model: upload a .glb file or paste an https:// URL.</div>;
  if (!attrs.alt) return <div style={{ ...notice, ...props.style }}>Add alt text that describes the model. It is required for screen-reader users.</div>;
  if (error) return <div style={{ ...notice, ...props.style }}>{error}</div>;

  // React passes unknown elements through; attributes are set in the effect above.
  const Tag = CONFIG.tagName as unknown as 'div';
  return (
    <div style={{ ...box, ...props.style }}>
      <Tag ref={ref as Ref<HTMLDivElement>} style={box} />
    </div>
  );
}

Viewer3D.displayName = CONFIG.displayName;

addPropertyControls(Viewer3D, {
  model: { type: ControlType.File, title: 'Model', allowedFileTypes: ['glb', 'gltf'] },
  modelUrl: { type: ControlType.String, title: 'Model URL', placeholder: 'https://…/model.glb', description: 'Overrides the uploaded file.' },
  alt: { type: ControlType.String, title: 'Alt text', placeholder: 'Describe the model', displayTextArea: true, description: 'Required. Read by screen readers.' },
  poster: { type: ControlType.File, title: 'Poster', allowedFileTypes: ['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'webp', 'avif'] },
  ar: { type: ControlType.Boolean, title: 'AR button', defaultValue: true },
  arLabel: { type: ControlType.String, title: 'AR label', placeholder: 'View in your space', hidden: (p: Viewer3DProps) => p.ar === false },
  iosModel: { type: ControlType.File, title: 'USDZ (iOS)', allowedFileTypes: ['usdz'], hidden: (p: Viewer3DProps) => p.ar === false },
  iosModelUrl: { type: ControlType.String, title: 'USDZ URL', placeholder: 'https://…/model.usdz', hidden: (p: Viewer3DProps) => p.ar === false },
  cameraControls: { type: ControlType.Boolean, title: 'Orbit & zoom', defaultValue: true },
  autoRotate: { type: ControlType.Boolean, title: 'Auto-rotate', defaultValue: false, description: 'Off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.' },
  rotationSpeed: { type: ControlType.Number, title: 'Speed', defaultValue: 30, min: 5, max: 180, step: 5, unit: '°/s', hidden: (p: Viewer3DProps) => !p.autoRotate },
  shadowIntensity: { type: ControlType.Number, title: 'Shadow', defaultValue: 1, min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.1 },
  exposure: { type: ControlType.Number, title: 'Exposure', defaultValue: 1, min: 0, max: 4, step: 0.1 },
  transparent: { type: ControlType.Boolean, title: 'Transparent', defaultValue: true },
  background: { type: ControlType.Color, title: 'Background', defaultValue: '#FFFFFF', hidden: (p: Viewer3DProps) => p.transparent !== false },
  loading: { type: ControlType.Enum, title: 'Loading', options: ['lazy', 'auto', 'eager'], optionTitles: ['Lazy', 'Auto', 'Eager'], defaultValue: 'lazy' },
  tapToLoad: { type: ControlType.Boolean, title: 'Tap to load', defaultValue: false, description: 'Waits for a tap before downloading.' },
  licenseKey: { type: ControlType.String, title: 'Licence key', placeholder: 'EWV-…', description: 'For your published domain. Without it the published site shows a small "Unlicensed" link. viewer.elliottwave.studio/pricing' },
});
